items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus) inactive/doubtful confirmed out; expected Week 3.
items.why: Limited Friday practice post-meniscus trim; Rapoport next week; inactives confirm.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer increased snaps/targets; Jeanty checkdowns.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active today after cracked rib injury and optimism reports; will wear flak jacket.
items.why: Practiced Friday, improved steadily, team did not elevate WR, Rapoport bullish tone, Schefter confirmation.
items.implication: Start with slight docks possible due to rib/flak; volume expected in Chargers offense vs Raiders.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets if limited soreness; monitor snaps early.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today with hamstring; was not expected to play.
items.why: Hamstring limited practice; ETR/Levitan flagged not expected; Schefter/Berry confirm inactive.
items.implication: Sit; opens backfield looks for backups.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Jonah Coleman or other Broncos RBs.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed ruled out (neck) after being carted off on backboard; RT also out.
items.why: Carted, neck injury, team ruled out.
items.opportunity: Increased routes for Christian Watson, Dontayvion Wicks, Kraft.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor return; Gainwell handcuff elevated if out.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT rest of game, Kenny Gainwell snaps/carries/RZ.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave is active; expected to play through hamstring after being questionable.
items.why: Schefter expected to play AM; ETR/Levitan clean no docks; Rap corroboration on expected.
items.implication: Start as WR2/3; full target share expected vs Ravens.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow, listed questionable (back), is officially active and will start vs Texans.
items.why: Coach indicated good to go; Rapoport confirmed will play; Schefter active list.
items.implication: QB1 start despite tough matchup; Chase/Higgins volume intact.

items.text: Sunday AM GTD/expected/out: McConkey optimism+flak GTD, Nacua GTD, Harvey not expected, Olave/Burrow/Black/McMillan expected (snap count), Flowers/Pittman OUT.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports for fantasy; high-value status window.
items.implication: Lineup locks based on expected/OUT; monitor GTDs to inactives.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for OUTs as noted by Levitan.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled out; Boutte/Schultz volume up.
items.why: Missed practice, Grade 1 confirmed earlier; inactives.
items.implication: Sit; stream Schultz TE or Boutte WR.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz targets, other HOU WRs.

items.text: Tua Tagovailoa inactive (oblique); Falcons QB situation impacted.
items.why: Oblique; Schefter list with other actives.
items.implication: Falcons offense without Tua (Penix also out).
items.opportunity: ATL skill players may see adjusted usage.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official likely ~2:30pm ET; flak jacket expected.
items.why: Optimism from practice/improvement; docks for rib; later confirmed active.
items.implication: DFS/season start with volume caveat; projections updated.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if active; monitor early snaps.

items.text: Olave sounds fine no real docks; expecting decent look at Jonah Coleman with Harvey doubtful; Germie Bernard with Pittman out. Puka true GTD.
items.why: ETR weekend summary + player-specific docks/beneficiaries; projections updating.
items.implication: Olave start clean; stash/stream Coleman/Bernard; pivot Nacua.
items.opportunity: Coleman RB snaps/carries; Bernard WR targets/YAC; Olave full usage.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) true pregame GTD for MNF; trending wrong way per some reports, missed Fri/Sat practice.
items.why: Missed two practices; Schefter pregame decision and wrong-way notes; ETR/Levitan true GTD; Whittington doubtful.
items.implication: Have pivot ready (Adams primary); risky start Sunday lock.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Davante Adams target spike; other Rams WRs.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) officially ruled out; Bateman expected bigger role.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday; confirmed inactives; ETR/Schefter/Berry align.
items.implication: Sit; Andrews TE1 bump, Bateman WR upside.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Bateman, Andrews, Likely.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) downgraded to out; Bernard stash opportunity.
items.why: Foot injury, no Friday practice; Rap/ETR/Levitan confirm; Berry agrees Bernard.
items.implication: Sit Pittman; Metcalf primary, Bernard deep stash.
items.opportunity: Targets for DK Metcalf, Germie Bernard, others.

items.text: Agrees Germie Bernard deep stash with Pittman out; good fit for McCarthy offense, YAC man.
items.why: Pittman OUT opens targets; Bernard YAC profile fits.
items.opportunity: Slot/YAC targets in Steelers pass game.

items.text: Loves Kenneth Walker (util/tgts vs IND), Ashton Jeanty (99 util), Bucky Irving (tgt/RZ), Justin Jefferson (Wentz vol), Dak Prescott (smash vs WAS), Dalton Kincaid, Mike Evans/DeVonta Smith.
items.why: Usage (Walker 74% snaps/40% tgt routes; Jeanty util; Irving RZ; Jefferson Wentz history; Dak home/total; etc.).
items.implication: Strong starts; Walker/Jeanty RB1-2, Jefferson WR1, Dak QB1.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/RZ shares in favorable spots.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne (Kamara squeeze), Marvin Harrison Jr. (low share), Brian Thomas Jr., Harold Fannin.
items.why: Role/competition (Etienne vs Kamara; MHJ share; BTJ matchup/shadow; Fannin limited).
